verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīl
verses.translation: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
Did He not frustrate their scheme
For He sent against them flocks of birds
that pelted them with stones of baked clay
leaving them like chewed up straw
